points: They heard what Judas and Jonathan were doing and wanted a name of their own.
Nobody sent them. The spirit was on Judas and Jonathan, not on them, and they went under the guise of good intentions.

note.label: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel

points: They were self-willed and would not follow the men before them. Men want to recreate the wheel when the blueprint is laid out already.

note.label: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel

points: Two thousand men of Israel were slain that day over a mighty deed nobody asked them for.

note.label: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel

points: “Now what time as Judas and Jonathan were in the land of Galaad, and Simon his brother in Galilee before Ptolemais, Joseph the son of Zacharias, and Azarias, captains of the garrisons, heard of the valiant acts and warlike deeds which they had done. Wherefore they said, Let us also get us a name, and go fight against the heathen that are round about us.” These men wanted to make a name for themselves like Judas and his brethren.

note.label: False New Year: Doctrine Slayer - True Past Curses & Trauma

points: They went toward Jamnia, Gorgias came out against them, Joseph and Azaras were put to flight, “and there were slain that day of the people of Israel about two thousand men. Thus was there a great overthrow among the children of Israel, because they were not obedient unto Judas and his brethren, but thought to do some valiant act.” The ones left in charge to watch over the people tried to be brave and make a name for themselves, and got people killed in the process: pretenders, not real leaders.

note.label: False New Year: Doctrine Slayer - True Past Curses & Trauma

points: “Moreover these men came not of the seed of those, by whose hand deliverance was given unto Israel.” There is a certain seed the Lord raises up to bring forth deliverance to the people, and everybody is not that seed. Some are meant to watch the doors. There are many Israelites now who are Israel, but not the particular group the Lord is using to bring understanding to the people.

There is a special seed set up in each captivity: in Babylon’s time Daniel, Ezekiel, Jeremiah and Isaiah; in Persia Zerubbabel, Mordecai, Esther and Joshua; in Greece the Maccabees; in Christ’s time the disciples; and even now.

note.label: False New Year: Doctrine Slayer - True Past Curses & Trauma

points: “Howbeit the man Judas and his brethren were greatly renowned in the sight of all Israel, and of all the heathen, wheresoever their name was heard of”: their names were known, even among the heathen.

note.label: False New Year: Doctrine Slayer - True Past Curses & Trauma

points: “At that time certain priests, desirous to shew their valour, were slain in battle, for that they went out to fight unadvisedly.” You have to follow counsel and do as you are told, or you get yourself hurt. You are not cut out for that battle.
